messages.content: 計算一家公司的利潤率，其收入為200,000美元，支出為150,000美元。

function.name: calculate_ROI
function.description: Calculate the Return on Investment (ROI) for a given investment amount and net profit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

investment_amount.description: The initial amount of money invested. This is a float type value.

net_profit.description: The profit made from the investment. This is a float type value.

duration_years.description: The duration of the investment in years.

message.content:
公司利潤率（Profit Margin）= \(\frac{\text{營業利潤}}{\text{營業收入}}\times 100\%\)

營業利潤 = 營業收入 – 營業成本  
= \$200,000 – \$150,000  
= \$50,000

利潤率 = \(\frac{\$50,000}{\$200,000}\times 100\% = 0.25\times 100\% = 25\%\)

**答案：** 這家公司在此期間的利潤率為 **25%**。
